name: pad-events
command: while ! pad watch --help >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 3600; done; exec pad watch --stream --for-session
description: Pad item events: explicit subscriptions (pad watch <ref>) and items addressed to you (currently: assignment — ask-events are reserved in the wire contract but not yet emitted). Silent when the pad CLI isn't installed, no .pad.toml is present, or padd is unreachable.
